clara_cs: Weekly health check for CedarCommerce (private/VPC). Quick summary first:
- Overall account: GREEN -> most traffic stable, one region with elevated errors.
- Regions: us-east4 uptime 99.99%; eu-central1 99.95% w/w; ap-northeast1 dipped to 99.70% (connectivity flaps Mon 02:13 UTC).
- Latency: ap-northeast1 p95 ~1.9s (baseline 0.7s), p99 ~4.2s during flaps.
- Error rate: ap-northeast1 0.9% (target <0.2%), mostly 502/503 gateway responses.
- KMS/HSM: nina, saw a burst of HSM auth retries Wed ~05:40 UTC (300s window) causing 429 on the HSM pool.
- Spend: committed capacity usage 66% but regional burst patterns could push eu-central1 toward a cap bump next month.
- Onboarding: infra-runbook review scheduled Fri, enablement call Thu 9am PT.
- Renewal risk: Low-medium unless ap-northeast1 stabilizes.

Action items: tom -> investigate ap-northeast1 gateway queueing; nina -> validate HSM pool capacity and backoff behaviour; dave -> check client retry config and share recommended settings for customer.

tom_sre: taking ap-northeast1. Initial look: gateway queue shows spikes coincident with customer batch jobs at 02:10 UTC. Posted short trace and gateway logs: https://dash.internal/gw/trace/cedar/2140012345

ops-bot: ALERT: 2026-03-18 05:42 UTC — HSM pool 2 in eu-central1 entered throttling (429) for 6m. Ticket KMS-772 created.

nina_kms: confirmed the HSM burst. It looks like the customer's SA did ~1200 auth ops in 5m due to a scripted key-check loop. We recommended adding jitter & exponential backoff. Also checking if we can raise HSM concurrency for that tenant temporarily.

clara_cs: noted. Evan (customer): can you confirm if any scheduled jobs ran Wed early morning? We want to correlate.

evan_client: yes, we kicked off a nightly sync at 02:05 UTC. It retries on transient errors; I'll ask infra to add jitter and reduce retries.

dave_eng: I reviewed SDK configs used by Cedar. They were using retries=5, retry_delay_ms=200 fixed. Recommend: retries=3, base_delay=250ms, jitter=50-250ms. Also enable client-side batching (max_batch=16) to reduce many tiny requests.

tom_sre: helpful. After reducing client retries in a canary customer cluster we saw small-request rate drop 48% and gateway queue_wait_ms median fall from 380ms -> 70ms.

nina_kms: regarding HSM rotation: we have a planned HSM maintenance Fri 03:00 UTC that could overlap with Cedar's window. I'll coordinate and request a short deferral if they prefer.

clara_cs: thanks. I'll propose rescheduling maintenance with the KMS team if Cedar wants it. Evan, want us to delay maintenance?

evan_client: yes please delay by 24h if possible. We'll throttle the nightly job tonight after we push the retry changes.

tom_sre: posted log excerpt showing the 503s: ```[2026-03-16T02:12:18Z] gw=gw-12 req_id=0x9b3a status=503 queue_wait=412ms target=svc-frontend```

clara_cs: next steps summary: 1) Cedar infra to apply client retry jitter (evan) by EOD; 2) Dave to send exact SDK config snippet and rollout note; 3) Tom to monitor ap-northeast1 for 24h and report p95/p99; 4) Nina to request HSM maintenance deferral and open temporary concurrency increase request.

dave_eng: sharing SDK snippet in convo: ```
// recommended client config
retries: 3
base_delay_ms: 250
jitter_ms: [50,250]
max_batch: 16
```

nina_kms: KMS ticket KMS-772 now has a request for temporary concurrency bump (tenant=cedarcommerce) and maintenance deferral. Assigned to kms-oncall.

ops-bot: UPDATE: KMS-772 -> investigating (assigned kms-oncall).

clara_cs: I'll update the renewal note: flagging short-term risk but still on track. If after mitigation ap-northeast1 p99 stays >3s or spend projection exceeds committed cap, we'll escalate renewal risk to medium. I'll send slides for Thu enablement.

evan_client: thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick triage. Send the checklist and we'll share with infra team.

tom_sre: will post 6h follow-up metrics and baseline charts here in ~6h.

clara_cs: good work team. Closing loop when metrics confirm improvement. :white_check_mark:
